about: Standalone NARS growth / room-for-improvement data: per-team decay outlook, component levers, upside opponents, and the event guide. This file backs a planned "Growth / Room for Improvement" tool for the future NARS stats site; it is intentionally published as a separate data file and is not rendered on team pages. (Avery, Oct 14, 2026)

upside_opponents.note: Banded view at current ratings and RDs, ranked opponents only. Next rung: the teams ranked directly above. Realistic stretch: higher rated opponents within 350 points, ranked by expected value of playing them. Ceiling reference: the projected gain for beating the current number 1 team, shown for scale only. Projected gains replay the engine's own Glicko-2 update with diminishing returns included.
upside_opponents.ev_method: Expected value uses the engine's win probability at current ratings: EV = P(win) x gain if win + P(loss) x delta if loss.
